title: Signed envelope
description: What /v1/catalog.json contains. The catalog (schemas/catalog.schema.json) is the JSON text in `signed`; each signature covers exactly the bytes of that text. One file means a catalog and its signature can never be out of step.

signatures.description: More than one while a signing key is being replaced.

key.description: First 8 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the raw public key.
